rulings.model: The text supports each of boxes 2b, 2c and 2d being "the portion of the amount in box 2a", which justifies checking each one against 2a. It does not say these components are mutually exclusive, so whether their sum may exceed box 2a cannot be judged from the text given.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: project retained pending T-006. Boxes 2b, 2c and 2d are each 'the portion of the amount in box 2a'; whether the sum test (2b + 2c + 2d not more than 2a) assumes disjoint portions is the ambiguity-register candidate T-006, still undecided.
